run_images_to_video: run the script to convert images in a folder to an MP4 video with a specified FPS
create_video_from_images: create an MP4 video from a folder of PNG or JPG images using natural sort order
build_video_with_custom_fps: build a video from images in a directory with a custom frames per second rate
refactor_images_to_video: refactor the images_to_video function to support additional image formats or video codecs
review_images_to_video: review the images_to_video function that uses OpenCV to write frames to an MP4 video file
